description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples generated by high-throughput sequencing from agricultural fields across geographic regions, capturing geolocation, crop and management context, soil properties, and sequencing assay details for microbial community analysis.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record. Example: 'SAMPLE_0001'.

field_id.descr: Identifier for the agricultural field from which the sample was collected. Multiple samples may share the same field_id.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.descr: Country where the field is located. Use a standardized country name or ISO 3166-1 country name.

region.descr: Administrative or biogeographic region within the country, such as state, province, district, or county.

locality.descr: More specific location descriptor such as town, village, farm name, or site name.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees. WGS84 preferred. Example: 35.6895.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees. WGS84 preferred. Example: -120.6910.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level, in meters.

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the field at the time of sampling or during the sampled season. Use a controlled term when possible, e.g., maize, wheat, soybean, rice.

cultivar_variety.descr: Crop cultivar, variety, or hybrid name if known.

management_system.descr: Agricultural management system used in the field. Examples: organic, conventional, integrated, regenerative.

tillage_practice.descr: Soil tillage regime used in the field. Examples: no-till, reduced till, conventional till, strip-till.

irrigation_practice.descr: Irrigation status or method. Examples: rainfed, drip, sprinkler, flood irrigation.

fertilizer_use.descr: Fertilizer management description, including type and whether synthetic or organic inputs were used.

pesticide_use.descr: Pesticide/herbicide/fungicide use description, including presence/absence or application regime if known.

rotation_history.descr: Brief description of previous crops or crop rotation history relevant to the sampled field, if available.

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval from which the soil sample was collected, in centimeters. Example: 0-10 or a single depth value if standardized.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured for the sample or field soil. Unitless.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percentage by weight or volume, depending on the study protocol; specify method in accompanying documentation if needed.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture class determined from particle size distribution. Examples: sand, loam, silt loam, clay loam, clay.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of sampling, in degrees Celsius.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content, expressed as percent.

bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density, in grams per cubic centimeter, if measured.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: Name of the DNA extraction kit or protocol used for sample processing.

sequencing_assay.descr: Sequencing assay or target region used. Examples: 16S rRNA amplicon, ITS amplicon, metagenomic shotgun.

primer_set.descr: Primer pair or primer set used for amplicon sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used. Examples: Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run or merged reads, if applicable.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing.

sequencing_batch.descr: Sequencing batch, lane, run, or plate identifier used to track technical effects.

dna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: DNA concentration measured after extraction, in nanograms per microliter, if available.

dna_purity_ratio.descr: DNA purity ratio, such as A260/A280 or A260/A230, if available; state the metric in documentation or field notes.

crop_yield_kg_ha.descr: Crop yield for the field-season associated with the sample, expressed in kilograms per hectare, if measured.

yield_measurement_unit.descr: Unit used for yield reporting when crop_yield_kg_ha is not applicable or when alternative units are used. Example: kg/ha, t/ha, bushels/acre.

replicate_id.descr: Identifier for biological or technical replicate within the same field, location, or treatment group.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for unusual conditions, deviations from protocol, or additional context relevant to interpretation.
